rationale: HXL gapped down ~13% on earnings disappointment (unchanged guidance vs. elevated expectations) and is now trading mid-range at 62% of today's session range with no clear directional momentum — the last five 1-minute candles show a mild drift lower from ~81.06 to 80.61 but with inconsistent volume.
